# Veo Credit Waste Gate MCP

Paid remote MCP for Veo 4 credit waste gate MCP, structured receipts, audit logs, and reviewer-ready evidence.

Website: https://veocreditwaste.clauxel.com/
MCP endpoint: https://veocreditwaste.clauxel.com/mcp
Server card: https://veocreditwaste.clauxel.com/server-card.json
Docs: https://github.com/clauxel/veo-credit-waste-gate-mcp

Use case: Veo 4 credit waste gate MCP with structured receipts.
Authentication: Bearer token required for production use.
Tools: estimate_veo_job_cost, detect_duplicate_generation, check_media_budget, recommend_cheaper_variant, issue_spend_receipt
